item.title: Violating oil tanker explodes south of Strait of Hormuz: IRGC
item.description: The Islamic Revolution Guards Corps (IRGC) Navy says a violating oil tanker has exploded north of Ghannam Island in the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Iranian security forces capture intruding drone intact in Sistan and Baluchestan
item.description: Iranian security forces have seized control of an intruding unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) and brought it down intact in the southeastern province of Sistan and Baluchestan.

item.title: Iran reach AFC Beach Soccer Asian Cup 2026 final with 10-2 rout of Lebanon
item.description: Defending champions Iran secure a place in the final of the AFC Beach Soccer Asian Cup Thailand 2026™ and qualify for the 2027 FIFA Beach Soccer World Cup after overwhelming Lebanon 10-2 in the semi-finals.

item.title: Iran struck USS Abraham Lincoln on first day of war, Navy commander says
item.description: Speaking at Friday prayers in Tehran, Navy Commander Rear Admiral Shahram Irani said Iranian forces identified the central element of the enemy's military presence and fired their first untested missile at the aircraft carrier.

item.title: Iran's Ground Force at highest combat readiness, fully deployed along borders
item.description: Iranian Army Ground Force deputy operations commander says decades of aggression, sanctions and destabilization efforts have failed to achieve Iran's enemies' objectives.

item.title: IRGC forces US F-16 warplane to retreat from Iran’s airspace
item.description: The Islamic Revolution Guards Corps says a US F-16 warplane that had approached Iranian airspace near the Persian Gulf Hengam Island changed course after receiving a warning shot from the country's air defense system.

item.title: ‘Precooked recipe for war’: Iran rejects role in deadly drone strike on Kuwait
item.description: The Iranian foreign minister describes as 'suspicious' the drone strike on Kuwait that killed Italian nationals.

item.title: Iran completes rail-laying on Chabahar-Zahedan line, advancing strategic trade corridor
item.description: The 480-kilometer rail-laying phase was finished in a record timeframe, bringing the mega-project to 96 percent physical completion ahead of schedule.

item.title: Exhibition in Germany highlights Minab school massacre as Iran demands justice for 168 victims
item.description: Iran's ambassador to Germany demands that the perpetrators of the Minab massacre be held accountable.

item.title: Iran: New air defense systems ready to confront enemy attacks
item.description: Since the latest war, Army specialists and personnel have used their technical expertise, creativity and sustained efforts to develop new defensive equipment, Sayyari explained.

item.title: Quds Force chief: Resistance Front to continue until Imam Mahdi’s global govt.
item.description: The Quds Force chief says the Resistance Front will continue until the establishment of the global government of Imam Mahdi (PBUH).

item.title: FM Araghchi rejects anti-Iran accusations in call with Italian FM, offers investigation
item.description: The diplomatic exchange comes after European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen rushed to implicate Iran in the incident and called for increased pressure on Tehran.

item.title: Gazan family builds wooden shelters atop the rubble of their home in Gaza City
item.description: As winter approaches, 38-year-old Palestinian Hisham Hamid races against time to build a wooden shelter for his family atop the ruins of their destroyed home in Gaza City.

item.title: Palestinians rally outside UNRWA headquarters in Beirut on solidarity day
item.description: Palestinians demonstrate in Beirut, calling for greater support for refugees on the International Day of Solidarity with the Palestinian People.

item.title: London Underground strike causes capital chaos
item.description: London Underground strike causes capital chaos as dispute over four-day week deepens.
